Move jsonEqual of applyPatch into the shared JSON value module

jsonEqual moves unchanged from json-patch.ts to the internal
json-value.ts, so that createPatch can compare values the same way the
test operation does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add createPatch to create a JSON Patch between two documents

createPatch(from, to) returns an RFC 6902 patch that applyPatch turns
from into to with, so that clients can send what changed rather than
the whole new version. Objects are compared member by member and arrays
are aligned with Myers' diff algorithm, so a change gives operations
where it is and an insertion does not rewrite later elements. Where one
replace is shorter than patching the parts, it is used instead. Inputs
are not modified and must be JSON values (InvalidDocumentError).
ADR 0004 and the README record the behaviour and the choices made.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
